features.title: Monster hunter
features.text: Slayers study dangerous creatures and prepare special hunting tools. Ten minutes of research lets them mark a creature of their level or higher as quarry.

features.title: Claim trophies
features.text: Defeat that quarry and take a trophy to strengthen your tools for the next hunt. Preparation gives a slayer an edge against a chosen foe.

review.notes: Provisional assessment of the named playtest, not the final class. The public playtest period has ended; the published rules may differ.

ratings.offense: 4–4.5 → 3.5–4.5. Provisional playtest estimate: quarry preparation and hunting tools enable focused damage.
ratings.defense: 3.5 → 3.5. Ten HP and martial defenses support front-line resilience.
ratings.support: 2 → 2–3. Tool choices can assist the party, though hunting a quarry is the main focus.
ratings.utility: 3.5 → 3–4. Knowledge and monster-hunting tools help investigations and preparation.
ratings.difficulty: 3.5 → 3.5. Research, quarry restrictions and trophy management add preparation overhead.
